title: NEM-5025 Completion: AI Differentiation Gaps
overview: Complete the remaining implementation gaps from NEM-5025 (AI Differentiation Epic). Research agents verified that while the epic was marked Done, several phases have significant missing functionality: Phase 3 (Threat immediate alerts), Phase 4 (Depth distance conversion), Phase 5 (Weather risk modifiers), Phase 8 (Package detection), and Phase 9 (Smoke/fire detection).

phases.name: Phase 3 Completion: Threat Detection Immediate Alerts
phases.objective: Implement auto-CRITICAL alerts for weapons with batch bypass for immediate processing

codebase: Threat detection model exists in model_zoo.py (lines 541-553)
Alert engine has _check_threat_detected() but no auto-escalation
Batch aggregator uses 90-second windows with no bypass mechanism
decisions: Add fast-path queue in batch_aggregator.py for high-priority threats
Create threat monitor service that auto-generates CRITICAL alerts
Add severity auto-mapping: gun/rifle/pistol→CRITICAL, knife→HIGH, bat/crowbar→MEDIUM

create.purpose: Auto-generate CRITICAL alerts when weapons detected

modify.changes: Add fast-path bypass for high-priority threats
Add auto-severity mapping for threat types
Invoke threat detection model during enrichment

unit: Test threat monitor auto-creates CRITICAL alert for gun detection
Test batch aggregator bypasses queue for high-priority threats
Test severity mapping: gun→CRITICAL, knife→HIGH, bat→MEDIUM
integration: End-to-end: weapon detection → immediate alert (no batch delay)
edge_cases: Low confidence weapon detection (should not bypass)
Threat detection during high system load

acceptance_criteria: Weapon detection triggers CRITICAL alert within 5 seconds (bypasses 90s batch)
Alert severity automatically set based on weapon type
Threat detection model invoked in enrichment pipeline

Update prompt context to include 'X feet from door' format

create.purpose: Convert normalized depth to real-world distance

modify.changes: Add calibration_data field for reference distances

Test proximity labels include distance estimates
Test format outputs 'X feet from front door' style
integration: End-to-end: detection → depth analysis → calibrated distance in prompt

acceptance_criteria: Nemotron receives 'Person is approximately X feet from front door' context

phases.name: Phase 8: Package Detection
phases.objective: Detect packages, track delivery/removal, and alert on suspicious package removal

codebase: EntityType.PACKAGE exists in enums.py but not used
decisions: Use Florence 2.0 or YOLO-World for zero-shot package detection
Add PACKAGE_DELIVERED and PACKAGE_REMOVED event types
Create package tracking service with zone-based state machine
Alert when package removed without household member present

create.purpose: Load and run package detection model

modify.changes: Add package detection to enrichment phases

unit: Test package detection model loads and infers
Test alert triggered when package removed without household member
integration: End-to-end: package appears → DELIVERED event → package disappears → REMOVED event
End-to-end: package removed by non-household → THEFT_SUSPECTED alert
edge_cases: Delivery person still present when package removed (legitimate)

acceptance_criteria: System detects packages in delivery zones
PACKAGE_DELIVERED webhook fires when package appears
PACKAGE_REMOVED webhook fires when package disappears
Alert generated if package removed with no household member in scene

phases.name: Phase 9: Smoke/Fire Detection
phases.objective: Implement life-safety smoke/fire detection with immediate alerting

codebase: No smoke/fire model in Model Zoo
decisions: Add YOLOv8 smoke/fire model to Model Zoo with CRITICAL priority
Implement immediate alert bypass (skip all batching)
Add FIRE_SAFETY notification channel with escalation

modify.changes: Register smoke/fire model with CRITICAL priority (never evict)
Add immediate bypass for smoke/fire detections
Update _check_smoke_fire() to query real SmokeFireResult table
Add FIRE_SAFETY channel with escalation support

unit: Test smoke/fire model loads with CRITICAL priority
Test model never evicted from VRAM
Test smoke detection triggers immediate alert (no batch delay)
Test fire detection uses FIRE_SAFETY notification channel
integration: End-to-end: smoke detected → immediate CRITICAL alert → FIRE_SAFETY notification
edge_cases: Steam/fog false positive handling (consecutive detection requirement)

acceptance_criteria: Detection triggers alert within 2 seconds (bypasses all batching)
FIRE_SAFETY notification channel delivers via all configured methods
Requires 2+ consecutive detections to reduce false positives

risks: Package detection may require fine-tuned model for accuracy
Smoke/fire false positives from steam, fog, or outdoor cooking
Camera calibration requires user setup per camera
Immediate alert bypass may cause notification fatigue if thresholds too low
open_questions: Should package detection use Florence 2.0 (zero-shot) or fine-tuned YOLO?
What smoke/fire model to use? (YOLOv8 variants available)
How to handle FIRE_SAFETY escalation? (SMS → phone call → alarm service)
